newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD EYES LATVIAN, LITHUANIA SHIPPERS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD EYES LATVIAN, LITHUANIA SHIPPERS.

text.p: Riga Shipyard, newly quoted on the stock exchange, on Monday said it will take part in the sale of Latvian Shipping and rival Lithuanian Klaipeda Ship Repair.

"The company has taken a strategic decision to participate in the privatisation of..Latvian Shipping..also Klaipeda ship repair..to guarantee a minimum workload from local companies," Erik Kazha, Riga Shipyard chairman, told a news conference.
"With Klaipeda it will be more difficult as they are one of our biggest rivals, a more modern plant," Kazha said.
The company also said that it was trying to compensate for a lack of state support in securing orders from local ship-owners.
"We now have some 25 percent of our turnover provided by Latvian Shipping against working just for Latvian Shipping in 1990," Kazha said.
He said that the Lithuanian government supports the local ship repair industry by ordering compulsory ship repairs.
A similar situation was currently developing in Estonia, Kazha said.
He also said that Riga Shipyard will branch out into the shipping business.
"We would be able to earn from operating a ship for which there is no immediate demand and sell it at a later date," Kazha said.
